title: Returned-Channel Addition Schedule for Rental Returned-Payment Fees
content:
A Rental Property Service Contracts returned-payment fee carries a returned-channel addition set by how the returned payment had been made.

| How the returned payment had been made | Returned-channel addition |
|---|---|
| by check | $5.00 |
| by card | $10.00 |
| another way (for example by ACH) | $0 |

**Records read.** The most recent returned payment charge names the payment by its payment confirmation number; the premium payment posted with that same confirmation number shows the payment method.

**How the addition acts.** The addition is a dollar amount added to the returned-payment fee, before any percentage reduction of the fee.

*Hypothetical:* a returned payment whose original posting shows payment by check adds $5.00; one by card adds $10.00; one whose original posting shows ACH adds nothing.
